# Code of Conduct

## Our standard

Discord Verification Bot welcomes contributors and users from different
backgrounds and experience levels.

Participation in this project should remain constructive and respectful.

Examples of expected behavior include:

- Giving useful and respectful feedback.
- Respecting differing technical opinions.
- Accepting reasonable criticism.
- Keeping discussions relevant to the project.
- Helping other contributors when possible.
- Respecting user privacy and security.

## Unacceptable behavior

The following behavior is not acceptable:

- Harassment, threats, or targeted abuse.
- Discrimination against other participants.
- Publishing another person's private information without permission.
- Deliberately disrupting project discussions.
- Spam or malicious contributions.
- Knowingly submitting malware, backdoors, credential stealers, or other intentionally harmful code.
- Exploiting project infrastructure or users.
- Publicly disclosing unresolved security vulnerabilities when doing so would put users at risk.

Disagreement, criticism, and technical debate are allowed. They should
remain focused on the work rather than personal attacks.

## Enforcement

Project maintainers may edit, remove, reject, or lock contributions and
discussions that violate these expectations.

Repeated or serious violations may result in temporary or permanent
restrictions from participating in project spaces.

## Scope

This Code of Conduct applies to official Discord Verification Bot project
spaces, including the repository, issues, pull requests, discussions, and
other spaces managed by the project maintainers.
